issues.description: The Bitmap24 constructor is declared with three parameters in the template header but defined with two parameters in the template implementation. Specifically, template header (template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp line 38) declares Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth), while the template implementation (template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp line 26) defines Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). The solution repository uses the two-parameter constructor (solution_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp line 38 and solution_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp line 26). This mismatch between declaration and definition in the template will cause compilation errors or confusion for students about which constructor signature is the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header and implementation consistent with the solution. Prefer changing the template header declaration to the two-parameter form: Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (remove the extra 'depth' parameter). Alternatively, implement a matching three-parameter constructor in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp, but aligning the header to the two-parameter signature is recommended to match the solution and avoid confusing students.
